body:
![Binary Dimension](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0cf4ba2de836ebd3567216b47e1f3fc08d244656.png)

# OVERVIEW_
Explore a whole new matrix dimension with unique computer-related mobs, biomes and machines.

Some features:
- Explore void, hexadecimal & binary biomes
- Fight bugs, viruses & worms
- Craft food, health & repair machines
- Use bitcoin miner and browse minecraft dark web 
- Set up automated turrets and flying vehicle
- Store your items in SD cards
- Play with cursed blocks with unique properties

# GETTING_STARTED_
You need to eat the red pill. Craft it with bytes and red dye, all the crafts are explained in JustEnoughItems.
If you encounter any issue, report it [here](https://github.com/BinaryQuantumSoul/BinaryMod/issues).

# COMPATIBILITY_
Available in English, French and Esperanto.

Fully compatible with [JEI](https://modrinth.com/mod/jei) and [HWYLA](https://modrinth.com/mod/hwyla).
